FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 41
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2023
Senate Bill 41 as introduced would provide one additional circuit court judgeship in the 19th,
23rd, and 28th Judicial Circuits. According to the Administrative Office of Courts, this would
increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated $1.01 million dollars for
fiscal year 2025 and a minimum of $1.35 million dollars for fiscal years 2026 through 2031.
